$comment: SSoT for MCP servers across all agents. `agents-sync mcp sync` writes scope=global servers into every agent's user config (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI; Hermes via the flake's lib.mcpServers); scope=project servers are opt-in per repo via `agents-sync mcp enable <name>`. `skip` lists agents that get the server another way (e.g. a Claude Code plugin from settings.json). No secrets here: OAuth logins live in each agent's own store, API keys in sops. Must stay unencrypted: the flake reads it at evaluation time.

browse.description: Drive the user's real Chrome-family browser (logins, tabs) via the browse extension.

cloudflare-api.description: Cloudflare API in code mode (search + execute; covers the whole API with two tools).

cloudflare-bindings.description: Workers bindings: KV, R2, D1, Hyperdrive.

cloudflare-builds.description: Workers Builds: deployments and build logs.
